source.sha256_method: sha256 over 3 tables' full unfiltered COPY (ORDER BY <pk>) WITH (FORMAT CSV) output, each preceded by a 'TABLE:<schema>.<table>' header line, concatenated in fixed alphabetical order: nq_basicdata.stock, nq_sdidata.dataperiod, nq_sdidata.sdi
source.reuse_note: nq_basicdata.stock content overlaps byte-for-byte with the batch already pinned by security_master/security_profile/financial_facts/quote_snapshot/corporate_actions, but this promotion's own correctness argument depends on the exact 3-table set it reads together (entity scope + the SDI extraction window + the filing stream itself), so it mints its own self-contained batch rather than cross-referencing another promotion's pin -- same reasoning every prior promotion used for its own batch.

promotion.new_migration_reason: Unlike the five prior Netquity live-promotion slices (their domain values -- security_master, financial_fact, quote_snapshot, corporate_action -- already existed in aiphabee_core.serving_dataset_domain_check as of 20260625002000_hkex_news_ingest_foundation.sql), no 'sdi_disclosure'/'disclosure_of_interest'/'ownership' domain value existed anywhere in the schema. deploy/database/migrations/20260715150000_sdi_disclosure_domain.sql extends the CHECK constraint (drop + re-add, the same mechanism 20260624001000_ipo_pipeline_foundation.sql and 20260625002000_hkex_news_ingest_foundation.sql each used to add a new domain value) with no table creation, access grant, or data load.
promotion.serving_dataset_domain_note: dataset and domain use the identical value 'sdi_disclosure' (no plural/singular mismatch this cut, unlike corporate_actions/corporate_action or financial_facts/financial_fact): both are new values minted together by this promotion, so no pre-existing naming convention constrained a match.
promotion.new_index_required_reason: entity_id lookup uses the leading prefix of the existing serving_record unique index (serving_snapshot_id, entity_type, entity_id, ...)

rights_basis.distinct_from_quote_snapshot: quote_snapshot deliberately uses its own 'netquity-market-data-staging.v1' policy version because market-data Web distribution rights were confirmed separately; SDI has no comparable separate rights determination and is covered by the original Netquity collaboration rights approval already used by security_master/security_profile/financial_facts/corporate_actions, so this promotion reuses 'netquity-collaboration-staging.v1' rather than minting a new policy version.
rights_basis.account_context_independence: resolveSdiDisclosure filters aiphabee_governance.data_entitlement/aiphabee_core.serving_dataset by context.rights_policy_version (the account's platform.workspace_product_access.policy_version), the same as resolveProfile/resolveFinancialFacts/resolveCorporateActions -- no hardcoded policy-version constant is introduced.
rights_basis.personal_data_basis: the substantial shareholder / director name carried by holderName is the statutorily public SFO Part XV disclosure this dataset exists to publish (the same public-monitoring-data basis security_profile already uses for company/director identity), not incidental personal data collected for another purpose; no other personal-data field is promoted (see excluded_from_this_cut.personal_data_columns).

field_mapping.vendor_source: nq_sdidata.sdi.formtype (raw code '1'|'2'|'3A', not translated to an English label)
derived: which of l_/s_/p_ column blocks is populated on the row ('long'|'short'|'pool')
derived: 'available' (code has >=1 sdi row) | 'unavailable' (code has 0 sdi rows)
derived static text, only present when coverage.status = 'unavailable'

excluded_from_this_cut.nature_of_change_category: l_/s_/p_eventcode has no decode table anywhere in the mirrored schema (68 distinct long-block values, 32 distinct short-block values, 0 pool-block values populated). Promoting a translated 'increase'/'decrease'/'passive' nature-of-change category (the sdi.jsx design fixture's kind/kindZh fields) would assert an interpretation of an undocumented numeric code, the same risk corporate_actions declined for nq_capitalraised.methodcode. The raw eventCode is promoted verbatim (opaque string) instead; no kind/kindZh field is emitted.
excluded_from_this_cut.threshold_crossing_flag: no vendor column encodes a disclosure threshold crossing (e.g. the sdi.jsx design fixture's 'crossing' field, '上穿 30% 披露界线'). Deriving it would require applying an SFO threshold-crossing rule engine to previousBalancePercent/presentBalancePercent after promotion -- interpretation, not 1:1 projection, the same category of derivation corporate_actions declined for split/consolidation ratios. Not promoted; not computed client-side from the promoted percentages either.
excluded_from_this_cut.on_exchange_dealing_price: l_/s_/p_onex_highprice and l_/s_/p_onex_avgprice (on-exchange dealing price stats during the reporting period, ~35-37% populated on the long block) are not promoted this cut: not part of the sdi.jsx design vocabulary this cut targets, and out of scope alongside the two fields below.
excluded_from_this_cut.off_exchange_consideration_fields: l_/s_/p_offex_consshare and l_/s_/p_offex_conscode are not promoted: offex_conscode is a 4-value undocumented code (3101/3102/3103/3104, no decode table anywhere in the mirrored schema); offex_consshare's own populated values (e.g. 84.0411 on a row whose onex_avgprice is 84.0782) numerically resemble a per-share consideration price rather than a literal share count despite its 'consshare' name -- an ambiguity this promotion declines to resolve by guessing a field semantic rather than reading a vendor definition.
excluded_from_this_cut.personal_data_columns: verified: nq_sdidata.sdi's full column set (code, reportdate, transdate, formtype, formno, formno2/formno2_a/formno2_s, chisubsharename/engsubsharename/simsubsharename, sharetype, and the l_/s_/p_ position blocks of eventcode/no_of_share/transcurr/onex_highprice/onex_avgprice/offex_consshare/offex_conscode/previousbalshare/previousbalper/presentbalshare/presentbalper) carries no address, identity-document number, date-of-birth, or contact-detail column. Only the statutorily public holder name (chisubsharename/engsubsharename/simsubsharename) is promoted, matching the task's PII stop condition: no vendor-appended personal-data field exists to exclude.

entity_scope_choice.rationale: financial_facts' Serving scope is only codes present in ANY finreport table, because its bank/insurance carve-out needs its own coverage marker distinct from true absence -- there is no comparable 'known but structurally out of scope' bucket for SDI (any listed instrument could in principle have a substantial-shareholder/director disclosure). A disclosure-of-interests filing is also a rare, transient event: for the 16821 remaining instruments, 'no filing in the mirrored window' is the default state for the large majority of the market, not an anomaly warranting the 404 not_found status used for 'this instrument id does not exist'. Building the full 18036-instrument universe with an explicit coverage.status=unavailable marker (quote_snapshot/corporate_actions' idiom) keeps that distinction, and lets the new SdiDisclosurePanel render a calm EmptyPanel state instead of an error card.

web.synthetic_counterpart: none -- unlike the actions/quote/financials tabs (each decoupled from a pre-existing synthetic packages/workbench section), SDI never had a synthetic scaffold anywhere in packages/workbench: it is a genuinely new tab, not a synthetic->live cutover of an existing one. The tab's status dot therefore has no StockWorkbenchSection key to read and renders neutral rather than a fabricated found/not-found state.

rollback.revert_domain_migration: only if no other serving_dataset row ever adopts domain='sdi_disclosure'; otherwise the CHECK constraint extension is additive and safe to leave in place
